 How to Watch Celtics vs Bulls
 When: Friday, October 30, 2026
 Time: 7:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: Chicago Sports Network, NBC Sports Boston
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Boston enters Friday's matchup looking to repeat its dominant performance from Monday, when the Celtics cruised to a 134-99 victory over Chicago. Payton Pritchard led the way with 28 points, including seven 3-pointers, while Jayson Tatum contributed 23 points, seven rebounds and six assists. The Celtics have won three straight games following their season-opening loss to Detroit, and their combination of perimeter shooting and offensive firepower makes them a dangerous opponent.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Chicago will be looking for a much better showing after struggling to contain Boston's offense earlier in the week. Norman Powell led the Bulls with 20 points in Monday's loss, while rookie Caleb Wilson added 17 and Josh Giddey contributed 11. The Bulls will need stronger defensive execution and improved shooting to avoid another lopsided result. With both teams competing in East Group C of the NBA Cup, Friday's contest carries additional significance beyond the regular-season standings.
